author: Inquire II
title: SLSQP OptimizeResult Inspection for KKT Multiplier Extraction (Inquire II)
abstract: This experiment aims to inspect the `scipy.optimize.minimize` `OptimizeResult` object for the 'SLSQP' method to identify potential avenues for KKT multiplier extraction. The full attributes of the `res` object will be printed to stdout after running the SLSQP SOTA reproduction code. This will determine if Lagrange multipliers or dual variables are accessible, providing critical information for performing KKT analysis on the lineage's highest-scoring solutions.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import sys

sys.path.append('storage/inquire/circle_packing')

from slsqp_utils import pack_to_z, z_to_pack, objective, constraint_boundary, constraint_nonoverlap
from initial_guesses import generate_systematic_seed
from config import N_CIRCLES, SLSQP_OPTIONS, BOUNDS, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, SAFETY_FACTOR

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    print("--- Starting SLSQP OptimizeResult Inspection for KKT Multiplier Extraction ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    N = N_CIRCLES

    # Generate initial guess using the systematic seed from Eval ID 93
    seed_centers, seed_radii = generate_systematic_seed(N_circles=N)
    z0 = pack_to_z(seed_centers, seed_radii)

    # Run the optimization using SLSQP
    res = minimize(objective, z0, method='SLSQP', bounds=BOUNDS, constraints=CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, options=SLSQP_OPTIONS)

    print("\n--- OptimizeResult Object Attributes (SLSQP) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    for attr in sorted(dir(res)):
        if not attr.startswith('_'): # Avoid internal Python attributes
            value = getattr(res, attr)
            # Limit printing large numpy arrays or functions
            if isinstance(value, np.ndarray) and value.size > 10:
                print(f"  {attr}: <numpy.ndarray of shape {value.shape}>", file=sys.stdout)
            elif callable(value):
                print(f"  {attr}: <function/method>", file=sys.stdout)
            else:
                print(f"  {attr}: {value}", file=sys.stdout)
    print("--- End OptimizeResult Object Attributes ---", file=sys.stdout)

    # Extract final centers and radii
    final_centers, final_radii = z_to_pack(res.x)
    final_radii *= SAFETY_FACTOR
    score = np.sum(final_radii)
    
    print(f"\nSLSQP Optimization Success: {res.success}, Message: {res.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"SLSQP Optimized Score: {score:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)

    print("\n--- SLSQP OptimizeResult Inspection Complete ---", file=sys.stdout)
    return final_centers, final_radii
